text:
Alex (ops): Heads up — received 3 H100s at FRA crossdock. Packing list PO-4921 shows 3 units, but two units reporting thermal sensor mismatch on boot, one unit flagged DOA by depot tech. Can vendor confirm RMA path and whether dock surcharge/credit is covered?
Maria (procurement): @Sam any visibility on warranty/coverage for PO-4921? also need invoice/awbs to file claim.
Sam @GigaSupply: Sorry about this, Alex — looks like a packaging issue in that batch. Please drop serials + AWB and we'll pre-authorize RMAs right away. We can compensate dock fees up to €150/unit if reported <48h and photos/logs provided. Air-expedite is available at cost.
Jordan (logistics): We can hold the remaining stock but prefer to move healthy unit to edge node to keep capacity. Can vendor do same-day pickup for the two faulty units? Depot says pickup window is 72h.
Alex (ops): Serial list and AWB below:
- SN: H100-8234-XL (DOA)
- SN: H100-8235-XL (Thermal mismatch)
- SN: H100-8236-XL (Thermal mismatch)
AWB: 243-GBR-99871
Photos uploaded to #internal-assets/po-4921/
Logs:
```
THERM_SNSR: 78C (expected idle 45-55C)
KV_CACHE: init ok
POST_STATUS: FAIL_THERM
DEPOT_NOTE: "unit boots to 78C, fan rpm at max"
```
Sam @GigaSupply: Got the serials + logs, creating RMA now. We'll issue RMA authorizations RMA-2025-88 and RMA-2025-89 for the two sensor units, and RMA-2025-90 for DOA. Pickup ETA 72h unless you request air, in which case +€450/unit. Dock surcharge credit approved as noted — send the depot invoice to claims@gigasupply.com referencing RMA numbers.
ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2025-88, RMA-2025-89, RMA-2025-90. Link: https://rma.gigasupply.com/RMA-2025-88
Maria (procurement): Finance, please confirm cost center for any air-expedite charges — procurement approves vendor covering dock credits but not expedite unless pre-approved.
Sam @GigaSupply: Understood — we'll proceed ground pickup. If you change to air please @mention us within 6h so we can arrange.
Jordan (logistics): Can ops isolate the two units from the rack and tag them for pickup? I'll coordinate with depot and get pickup window confirmed.
Alex (ops): Will do — pulling units now and putting HOLD tag with AWB and RMA numbers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maria (procurement): tagging PO/finance: PO-4921 invoice #INV-2025-334 attached in assets.
Sam @GigaSupply: Once depot invoice is in, we'll process credit within 14 days. Apologies again, we'll push QC on outgoing batches.
Alex (ops): Quick note — we need a temporary loaner to avoid service degradation for the edge cluster. Jordan — any loaners available in EU pool?
Jordan (logistics): EU loaner pool has 1 H100 available — can dispatch same day to FRA. I'll put it on hold pending ops confirmation.
Alex (ops): Confirm yes, please hold and ship to FRA rack 7U.
ops-bot: Dispatch hold placed: LOANER-774, expires in 36h.
Sam @GigaSupply: Will follow up with root-cause once batch inspection completes.
Maria (procurement): Closing loop: vendor covers dock credit, RMAs authorized, loaner reserved. I'll update the PO notes.
Alex (ops): Closing — will report back once depot pickup and credits confirmed.
